topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I can't believe this is happening. After all the late nights and the stress, pouring my heart into this project, I find out someone is accusing me of plagiarism. Like I’d ever cheat. I’ve got principles, I’ve got standards. It’s insulting to even suggest I’d cut corners on something I care so deeply about. They obviously don’t understand how much effort I put into this. They’re going to regret this, I swear. I’m not just going to sit back and let them ruin my reputation and my future.
